ContactPilot.residual_three.statement:
theorem residual_three (x : ℂ) :
    A x * (-3)^2 + B x * (-3) + C x = x * H₃ x

ContactPilot.analytic_remainder_three.statement:
theorem analytic_remainder_three {v : ℂ → ℂ} (hv : AnalyticAt ℂ v 0)
    (hv₀ : v 0 = -3)
    (heq : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), A x*v x^2+B x*v x+C x = 0) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ h 0 ∧ h 0 = 3-2*Complex.I ∧
      ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), v x = -3 + x*h x

ContactPilot.imaginary_order_two.statement:
theorem imaginary_order_two {v h : ℂ → ℂ} (hv : AnalyticAt ℂ v 0)
    (hh : AnalyticAt ℂ h 0)
    (hrem : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), v x = -3+x*h x)
    (hh₀ : h 0 = 3-2*Complex.I) :
    analyticOrderAt (fun x : ℝ => ((x:ℂ)*v x).im) 0 = (2:ℕ)

ContactPilot.concrete_orders_six_two.statement:
theorem concrete_orders_six_two :
    ∃ u v g h : ℂ → ℂ,
      AnalyticAt ℂ u 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ v 0 ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ h 0 ∧
      u 0 = -1 ∧ v 0 = -3 ∧ g 0 = 17/4-Complex.I/2 ∧ h 0 = 3-2*Complex.I ∧
      (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), A x ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ t : ℂ, A x*t^2+B x*t+C x = 0 ↔ t = u x ∨ t = v x) ∧
        u x = P x+x^5*g x ∧ v x = -3+x*h x) ∧
      analyticOrderAt (fun x : ℝ => ((x:ℂ)*u x).im) 0 = (6:ℕ) ∧
      analyticOrderAt (fun x : ℝ => ((x:ℂ)*v x).im) 0 = (2:ℕ)

ContactPilot.branch_bounds.statement:
theorem branch_bounds {u v g h : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g 0) (hh : AnalyticAt ℂ h 0)
    (hg₀ : g 0 = 17/4-Complex.I/2) (hh₀ : h 0 = 3-2*Complex.I)
    (hgu : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), u x = P x+x^5*g x)
    (hhv : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), v x = -3+x*h x) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 0, 0 < |x| →
      ((x:ℂ)*u x).im < 0 ∧ ((x:ℂ)*v x).im < 0 ∧
      (1/4:ℝ)*|x|^6 ≤ |((x:ℂ)*u x).im| ∧
      |((x:ℂ)*u x).im| ≤ |x|^6 ∧
      |x|^2 ≤ |((x:ℂ)*v x).im| ∧
      |((x:ℂ)*v x).im| ≤ 3*|x|^2 ∧
      (1/4:ℝ)*|x|^6 ≤ min |((x:ℂ)*u x).im| |((x:ℂ)*v x).im| ∧
      min |((x:ℂ)*u x).im| |((x:ℂ)*v x).im| ≤ |x|^6

ContactPilot.R_expanded.statement:
theorem R_expanded (x w : ℂ) : R x w =
    (1-Complex.I*x-2*x^2+Complex.I*x^3)*w^2 +
    (4*x-(2+2*Complex.I)*x^2-x^3)*w+3*x^2-Complex.I*x^3

ContactPilot.R_zero.statement: theorem R_zero (w : ℂ) : R 0 w = 0 ↔ w = 0

ContactPilot.R_normalized.statement:
theorem R_normalized (x t : ℂ) :
    R x (x*t) = x^2*(A x*t^2+B x*t+C x)

ContactPilot.R_all_roots.statement:
theorem R_all_roots {u v : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hb : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ),
      ∀ t : ℂ, A x*t^2+B x*t+C x = 0 ↔ t = u x ∨ t = v x) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (0:ℂ), ∀ w : ℂ,
      R x w = 0 ↔ w = x*u x ∨ w = x*v x
